# Plan of Work

The RIBA Plan of Work is the definitive model for the design and construction process of buildings. Download the RIBA Plan of Work 2020 Overview for the complete guidance.

 [Download Plan of Work Overview](/media/syneeeto/2020ribaplanofworkoverviewpdf.pdf)

## RIBA Plan of Work core project strategies

This key suite of documents organise the process of briefing, designing, constructing and operating building projects into eight stages and explain the stage outcomes, core tasks and information exchanges required at each stage.

[Download your copy of the Plan of Work Overview](/media/syneeeto/2020ribaplanofworkoverviewpdf.pdf)

Guidance in the [**RIBA Plan of Work 2020 Overview**](/media/syneeeto/2020ribaplanofworkoverviewpdf.pdf "2020Ribaplanofworkoverviewpdf") is based on nearly seven years of feedback we have gathered from the construction industry. Alongside the following core project strategy guidance, there is a full glossary and comparison to international plan of work equivalents:

* Conservation Strategy
* Cost Strategy
* Fire Safety Strategy
* Health and Safety Strategy
* Inclusive Design Strategy
* Planning Strategy
* Plan for Use Strategy - download the **[RIBA Plan for Use Guide](/media/54tn0pr2/plan-for-use-guide-2021.pdf "Plan for Use Guide")**
* Procurement Strategy
* Sustainability Strategy - including detailed tasks aligned to the **[RIBA Sustainable Outcomes Guide](/media/b2lgzeoo/riba-sustainable-outcomes-guide-2019-pdf.pdf "RIBA Sustainable Outcomes Guide 2019 Pdf")** (PDF Download)

Also included below is an A4 Printer Friendly version of the overview, RIBA Plan of Work 2020 Template and the RIBA Plan of Work Toolbox, that contains a Design Responsibility Matrix.

![](/media/0jon5bpe/plan-of-work-wheel-graphic-clear.png?width=640&height=480&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dcf4ed95f28e00)

## Plan of Work Overlays

Supported by industry specialists, we publish overlays to provide detailed guidance on specific design and built environment considerations that can be implemented through each RIBA Plan of Work stage to enable informed decision making at the right time and with the right stakeholders, to support the best project outcomes.

* **[Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DfMA) Overlay](/media/tt0lvbgj/design-for-manufacture-and-assembly-overlay-to-the-riba-plan-of-work-2020-2nd-editionpdf.pdf "Design For Manufacture And Assembly Overlay To The RIBA Plan Of Work 2020 2Nd Editionpdf") (November, 2021) (PDF download)**
* **[Passivhaus Overlay](/media/oqsk5l1x/passivhaus-overlay-to-riba-plan-of-workpdf.pdf "Passivhaus Overlay To RIBA Plan Of Workpdf") (February, 2023) (PDF download)**
* **[Security Overlay](/media/chdhu0db/security-overlay-riba-plan-of-work-pdf.pdf "Security Overlay RIBA Plan Of Work Pdf") (April, 2023) (PDF download)**
* **[Inclusive Design Overlay](/media/tsvljys2/inclusive-design-overlay-for-the-riba-plan-of-work.pdf "Inclusive Design Overlay For The RIBA Plan Of Work")(July, 2023) (PDF download)**
* **[Engagement Overlay](/media/541nfcrq/riba-engagement-overlay-to-the-riba-plan-of-workpdf.pdf "RIBA Engagement Overlay To The RIBA Plan Of Workpdf") (January, 2024) (PDF download)**
* **[Smart Building Overlay](/media/j42me0a2/riba-smart-building-overlay-to-the-riba-plan-of-work-2024.pdf "RIBA Smart Building Overlay To The RIBA Plan Of Work 2024") (February 2024) (PDF download)**

Plan of Work Overlays

We have written a series of professional features to explain each of the overlays and how to adopt them

[![](/media/pg5ggufh/image-of-city-at-night-with-illuminated-buildings.jpg?width=484&height=484&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dc2c7ceb732130) 

Security Overlay

This Security Overlay provides guidance through each RIBA Plan of Work stage for everyone involved in the safe and secure design, construction and operation of any building](/work/insights-and-resources/professional-features/plan-of-work-professional-features/riba-plan-of-work-security-overlay/)  [![A slender high rise building with blue sky beside and above](/media/5bsjotb2/london_award_2024_67_southwark_street_building.jpg?width=484&height=484&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dc2c78765f5890 "A slender high rise building with blue sky beside and above") 

Design for Manufacture and Assembly Overlay

This Overlay provides guidance on implementing seven categories of Modern Methods of Construction through each RIBA Plan of Work stage](/work/insights-and-resources/professional-features/plan-of-work-professional-features/dfma-overlay-to-the-plan-of-work/)  [![A red building in the centre](/media/23ico3hs/london_awards_2025_the_greenhill_building_harrow_arts_centre_-external-_view_close_up.jpg?width=484&height=484&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dcf7f09ea99d80 "A red building in the centre") 

Passivhaus Overlay

This Passivhaus Overlay sets out key actions and processes needed at each of the RIBA Plan of Work stages for clients and project teams wishing to deliver Passivhaus-certified projects](/work/insights-and-resources/professional-features/plan-of-work-professional-features/passivhaus-overlay-to-riba-plan-of-work/)

[![](/media/uefcjxrg/goldsmith-street-tim-crocker-1.jpg?width=484&height=484&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dcd19f79308360) 

Inclusive Design Overlay

This Inclusive Design Overlay provides guidance on implementing inclusive design through each RIBA Plan of Work stage](/work/insights-and-resources/professional-features/riba-inclusive-design-overlay/)  [![](/media/lofhcagk/lucy-cavendish-college-exterior_photo_nick_guttridge.jpg?width=484&height=484&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dc2c7ceb6e1820) 

Engagement Overlay

This Engagement Overlay provides guidance on engagement through each RIBA Plan of Work stage to promote best practice and to ensure the most successful and collaborative project outcomes](/work/insights-and-resources/professional-features/plan-of-work-professional-features/riba-plan-of-work-engagement-overlay/)  [![](/media/jjdfncb5/illustrative-photograph-showing-people-studying-a-3d-hologram-of-city-planning.jpg?width=484&height=484&format=webp&autoorient=true&v=1dcf8d64fc25d60) 

Smart Building Overlay

We have developed a Smart Building Overlay to provide guidance on smart building technology through each RIBA Plan of Work stage, aligning decision making with project outcomes](/work/insights-and-resources/professional-features/plan-of-work-professional-features/how-riba-smart-building-overlay-can-help-architects/)

Additional key resources

[RIBA Plan of Work Toolbox (XLSX)](/media/qj1nfrg1/ribaplanofworktoolbox_jul2022.xlsx) [2020 RIBA Plan of Work Template (PDF download)](/media/sszn5kkt/2020ribaplanofworktemplatepdf.pdf) [Print friendly 2020 RIBA Plan of Work Overview (PDF download)](/media/unqjdnaw/printfriendly2020ribaplanofworkoverviewpdf.pdf)

Read guidance and advice from experts on implementing the Plan of Work
